reference.method: bounded dynamic programming on the complete versioned network

allowed_claims: Searches a low-cost feasible path in a finite versioned conformation-state network
Compares QAOA-observed candidates with an independent bounded classical path baseline
limitations: Intermediate states and transition scores are project-authored coarse-grained teaching data, not experimentally resolved kinetics
Path cost is dimensionless and must not be interpreted as time, rate, residence time, or free energy
The experiment does not predict protein structure, perform all-atom folding, or run quantum molecular dynamics
QAOA counts are finite-shot observation frequencies and are not transition probabilities
